propositions: The DC backend transport is built on pycontribs/jira library confined to an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra, imported lazily inside functions so rebar remains dependency-free.
DC transport methods return raw payload shapes (dicts) that rebar mappers already consume, never leaking jira.JIRA object model downstream.
PAT bearer auth is read from JIRA_PAT env var only; malformed [tool.rebar.jira] config fails loudly with ConfigError rather than degrading to env-only.
A non-https reconciler.base_url is rejected unless allow_insecure=true is set; certificate verification is never disabled and ca_bundle configures internal CAs.

Transient connectivity faults (ConnectionError, Timeout, TimeoutError) are retried with 2s/5s backoff; HTTP errors are not retried and raised as vendor-neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError for assignee failures.

Every TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe method has passing live test coverage against the J5 harness; resolved_statuses config defaults to {Resolved, Done, Cancelled} and configures the absence probe's resolved-status set.
